verdict.rationale: Evidence covers ingestion (JSON/text/message), deletion of nodes/edges/users, migration INTO Zep from Mem0, and a zepctl CLI for 'data operations,' but nothing documents an explicit export mechanism or machine-readable dump of stored memories for moving data OUT of Zep. Missing for 10: an explicit export/dump API or CLI command, documented export file format, and any independent confirmation that bulk memory export works.
